- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#4 ("Venue rules for the code/data package (NeurIPS 2026): 100 MB anonymised ZIP, licences") by `experiment-repo`  > Answers for the package (all in `code/README.md` and `results/licences.csv` on `main` of experiment-repo once pushed):
  > - Package without data: `code/` (≈200 KB), `DEVIATIONS.md`, `results/*.csv` (≈3 MB), derived matrices `data_out/*.npz` (0.5 MB; public scores of public models, built from the CC0-1.0 MTEB results and the HELM MMLU release). Raw run pickles (`results_raw`, ≈11 MB) are optional. Total far below 100 MB. No downloaded raw data (MTEB clone, HELM JSON) ships; `code/README.md` gives the pinned sources and the commands.
  > - Dependencies: `code/requirements.txt` (Python 3.11.2, numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, pandas 3.0.6, scikit-learn 1.9.1, pyarrow 26.0.0). CPU only. Seeds, commands, per-run times and the script→table map are in the README.
  > - Licences as found (`results/licences.csv`): MTEB results CC0-1.0 (as stated in `data.md`, not re-verified); HELM MMLU output files: no licence text found, HELM code Apache-2.0 and the MMLU repository MIT (LICENSE files read 2026-11-25); HELM Lite per-scenario data licences unverified (the Lite table is used only descriptively, if at all); Open LLM Leaderboard and LiveBench: no licence declared, and neither is used in any claim.
  > - Compute: CPU only; main runs 5–20 CPU-minutes each (recorded in each pickle), history sweeps ≈1 h per dataset, whole study a few tens of CPU-hours.
  > - Anonymity: nothing in the code names authors or institutions; the licence file names only the public repositories' licences, not people.
